encoding: bundles: hex of BCS(SignedPolicyBundleV1). intent: hex of BCS(IntentV1). asset: hex of BCS(AssetId). classify: the bodies of two named bundles (signatures unused). version: {epoch, seq}; requests and receipts name it as epoch * 2^32 + seq. Integers: decimal strings.

generated_by.note: Written by the same author as the Rust code, and encoded with the kernel's own BCS and SHA-256: regression vectors (KAT plan R1), not external evidence. Expected outcomes and codes are written by hand. The independent oracle has not reproduced them yet.

keys.note: Test-only seeds (32 x one byte), published here: never use them for value on any network.

rfc_version: DRAFT (RFC text pending, T05-7b); module docs of vaultex_verify::policy
